title: Form Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District and Set Tax Rate
ballot_label: Form Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District and Set Tax Rate. Question: Shall District be formed with a permanent tax rate of $1.97 per $1,000 assessed value beginning fiscal year 2027-28?
summary: Would form the Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District, combining the Mt. Angel Fire District and Monitor Rural Fire Protection District, effective January 1, 2027, only if both dissolution measures (24-526 and Clackamas 3-640) pass. Sets a permanent rate of $1.97 per $1,000 assessed value from July 1, 2027, replacing the two districts' rates. Employees and property transfer to the new district, governed by a five-member board elected November 3, 2026.
yes_means: A yes vote forms the Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District with a permanent tax rate of $1.97 per $1,000 assessed value, effective only if both dissolution measures also pass.
no_means: A no vote does not form the new district; the Mt. Angel and Monitor districts continue to operate separately under their current tax rates.
fiscal_impact: New permanent property tax rate of $1.97 per $1,000 of assessed value, first levied for fiscal 2027-28 (collection beginning November 2027); per the explanatory statement it is higher than the existing permanent rate of each district, whose rates would no longer be levied. Neither district has bonded debt; consolidation creates no new debt.
